class.name: WeldJoint2D
class.brief_description: A physics joint that rigidly connects two 2D physics bodies at a single point.
class.description: A physics joint that rigidly connects two 2D physics bodies at a single point. For example, several bodies can be attached to create a complex body.[br][br][b]Note:[/b] [PinJoint2D] behaves similarly when you set [member PinJoint2D.angular_limit_lower] and [member PinJoint2D.angular_limit_upper] to 0, but [WeldJoint2D] is simpler and faster.
